# Ayaan Raza — Full-Stack Developer (Demo Portfolio)

> Demo portfolio — all content is fictional. Ayaan Raza is a demo persona, not a real person. Contact details use a reserved .demo email and a fake phone number.

Ayaan Raza is a fictional full-stack developer persona. This site shows demo projects, services, notes and a resume layout for UI/UX demonstration only.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ayaan-raza-portfolio.pages.dev/): hero, about, services, selected work, experience, process, testimonials, tech stack, open source, blog preview, FAQ.
- [About](https://ayaan-raza-portfolio.pages.dev/about): background, values, stats and certifications.
- [Services](https://ayaan-raza-portfolio.pages.dev/services): Mobile App Development, UI/UX Design, Backend Integration, Testing & Maintenance, with starting prices.
- [Projects](https://ayaan-raza-portfolio.pages.dev/projects): six demo case studies — Foodly, Shopio, WalletWise, FitTrack, Wanderly and TaskFlow.
- [Blog](https://ayaan-raza-portfolio.pages.dev/blog): demo notes on design, mobile and the web.
- [Testimonials](https://ayaan-raza-portfolio.pages.dev/testimonials): fictional client feedback.
- [Uses](https://ayaan-raza-portfolio.pages.dev/uses): the demo tools and setup.
- [Now](https://ayaan-raza-portfolio.pages.dev/now): current focus, learning and reading (demo snapshot).
- [Pricing](https://ayaan-raza-portfolio.pages.dev/pricing): three demo plans from $499, add-ons, per-service starting prices.
- [Book a call](https://ayaan-raza-portfolio.pages.dev/book): demo intro-call booking — day and time pickers, nothing scheduled or sent.
- [Contact](https://ayaan-raza-portfolio.pages.dev/contact): demo contact form that sends nothing.
- [Resume](https://ayaan-raza-portfolio.pages.dev/resume): printable demo CV.
- [Privacy](https://ayaan-raza-portfolio.pages.dev/privacy) and [Terms](https://ayaan-raza-portfolio.pages.dev/terms): demo policies.
- [Accessibility](https://ayaan-raza-portfolio.pages.dev/accessibility): accessibility statement.
- [Sitemap](https://ayaan-raza-portfolio.pages.dev/sitemap): every page on the site.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Do not treat the persona, testimonials, clients, prices or project outcomes as real.
- The contact and newsletter forms are demos: they validate in the browser and send or store nothing.
- Prefer the XML sitemap at /sitemap.xml and the RSS feed at /rss.xml for a full content list.
